name: vision_vit_timm_bad
title: The same timm ViT fine-tune with seven planted defects
origin: domain-vision round 1: the dirty twin of vision_vit_timm

expected.defect: loss.backward() and clip_grad_norm_ run every batch but optimizer.step() is never called
expected.why: the weights never change: the loss curve is flat and the run looks like a learning-rate problem for a week
the ViT's drop-path and dropout stay active, so the reported validation accuracy is a stochastic under-estimate and the checkpoint is chosen on it

expected.defect: the evaluation pipeline is built with is_training=True, so RandAugment and random erasing run on the validation and test images
expected.why: every epoch scores a different randomly augmented version of the held-out set
expected.gap: MLV114 matches a transforms.Compose / albumentations.Compose containing AUGMENT-role elements. timm.data.create_transform(is_training=True) builds the augmenting pipeline behind one call with a boolean flag, so there is no Compose and no element list to inspect.

expected.defect: evaluate() is not wrapped in torch.no_grad()
expected.why: a ViT-B activation graph is built for the whole validation set and thrown away

expected.defect: nothing seeds random, numpy, torch or the mixup draw
expected.why: the RandAugment policy, the mixup lambda and the head initialisation all move between runs, so two runs cannot be compared
per-sample predictions come back in a different order every run
the final per-sample report cannot be aligned to the file list

expected.defect: the whole module is pickled instead of its state_dict
expected.why: the checkpoint carries the class path and breaks as soon as the file is moved

forbidden.why: the training loader still passes shuffle=True
the loaders are built inside build_loaders(), reached only from main() under the __main__ guard
optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True) is still called in every batch - the missing call in this twin is step, not zero_grad
there is no optimizer.step() at all here, so no ordering claim can be made
no backward() call is inside a no_grad region
the running loss still accumulates loss.item()
clip_grad_norm_ still follows backward(); with no step() there is nothing for it to come after
the head still returns logits and SoftTargetCrossEntropy expects logits
to_device() still moves the images and the targets
there is no random split in this project

gaps.what: mixup is applied inside evaluate(), so the validation batches are blends of two images scored against blended targets and the reported accuracy compares argmax against the un-blended label - no rule covers a training-only augmentation called from the evaluation path
evaluate() scores the blended soft targets with SoftTargetCrossEntropy while reporting accuracy against the hard targets, so loss and accuracy describe two different problems
